data.name: Sudhir Dhondge
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sudhir Dhondge has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 26, with an average of 11.33 and a quick strike rate of 133.33. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 34.0 overs, taking 17 wickets at an economy rate of 10.21. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
